how_to_enter: Offered in the carriage, immediately before the starter question, on any new file after one full clear.
rules: Two variants, with or without randomised evolutions. Species, moves, abilities and held items are all randomised. Encounters are generated continuously on the fly rather than from a fixed per-area table. Difficulty scales progressively by route tier.

how_to_enter: Receive your starter in the carriage, then talk to the scientist with a star icon beside the Flare Laboratory in Pueblo Lienzo.
rules: Not every type is offered, because some types have too few Pokemon. Wild encounters do not change; captures outside the chosen type are simply blocked. A species is capturable if any stage of its line touches the type.
